run_pickled_pipeline: run a pickled PipelineExecutor from a given file path using the launch_pickled_pipeline CLI
load_pickled_executor: load a pickled PipelineExecutor object from a file using dill and open_file
parse_pipeline_args: parse command-line arguments for the pipeline executor path using argparse
execute_pipeline_run: execute the PipelineExecutor.run() method after deserializing from a pickled file
open_pickled_file: open a binary pickled file using datatrove.io.open_file for deserialization
